source_name: MPCB Pune Emission Inventory and Source Apportionment
secondary_source: CPCB National Source Apportionment for PM2.5
geographic_coverage: Pune Municipal Corporation area, Maharashtra, India
description: Source apportionment results for PM2.5 in Pune derived from receptor modelling (CMB/PMF). These figures represent published reference estimates, NOT direct measurements and NOT ground truth for our ML model. They are used only to contextualise SHAP driver groupings.
methodology_note: Receptor model source apportionment. Different studies use different methodologies; results are indicative ranges, not fixed percentages.

traffic_transport.label: Traffic & Transport
traffic_transport.notes: Includes on-road vehicles (2-wheelers, 3-wheelers, 4-wheelers, trucks), vehicle exhaust PM2.5, brake/tyre wear, road dust resuspension from vehicles. Pune has high two-wheeler density.

industrial.label: Industrial & Manufacturing
industrial.notes: Pimpri-Chinchwad MIDC industrial area (auto manufacturing, chemicals, foundries). Includes stack emissions and fugitive dust. Major industries: Tata Motors, Bajaj Auto, Bharat Forge.

dust_construction.label: Dust & Construction
dust_construction.notes: Open dust (unpaved roads, open land), construction activity (Pune has significant ongoing infrastructure development), agricultural burning in surrounding areas.

domestic_biomass.label: Domestic & Biomass
domestic_biomass.notes: Residential cooking (LPG mostly urban, biomass in peri-urban), waste burning. Lower share in central Pune.

other_secondary.label: Secondary Formation & Other
other_secondary.notes: Secondary aerosol formation (sulphate, nitrate, organic aerosol), regional/long-range transport.

monitoring_stations_known.name: Lohegaon
monitoring_stations_known.notes: Near airport; relatively cleaner residential area

monitoring_stations_known.name: Katraj
monitoring_stations_known.notes: Dense traffic area; typically higher PM2.5

annual_mean_pm25_reference.note: Annual mean from available CPCB stations; actual values vary by station and year

seasonal_pattern.winter_oct_feb: highest — stable atmosphere, low boundary layer, reduced ventilation
seasonal_pattern.summer_mar_may: moderate — dust resuspension high, but better ventilation
